parsed.why: Protective state: broad 1993 gender-identity/public-accommodations law, hate-crime coverage, shield law and trans-panic repeal help, but national passport/facility regime and an old birth-sex custody record cap it.

Most-protective tier with visitor-relevant shield law, 2018 custody/strip-search policy by identity, hate-crime and nondiscrimination coverage; severe national border/document exposure still limits the score.

Second-worst legislative tier: school-only facility ban without enforcement, litigated care ban, no state gender-identity discrimination or hate-crime coverage; national border and facility regime dominates.
Worst tier: state-run facility restrictions, surgery-based birth-certificate ban, no gender-identity discrimination or hate-crime protection, adding a hostile local layer below the parent rating.

Most-protective tier: broad public-accommodations law covering hotels/restaurants, shield law, gender-neutral restrooms, hate-crime and trans-panic repeal; national border exposure remains the main cap.
